source_refs.exact_quote: Hi, how are you today?
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: I'm doing fine. My problem is that my boss keeps hitting on a co-worker, who really doesn't like the guy. What can I do to make it stop?
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: Boy, that's a tough one. You've got to handle a problem like that pretty diplomatically. Have you talked to your co-worker, the one the boss hits on?
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: I've tried to bring it up with her indirectly, but it's an uncomfortable issue, you know? She is really upset, and I don't know whether it's my place to handle this kind of thing. It's more of an HR issue, but should I go to HR? Will that help, or just get me in trouble? I don't know.
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: That's a good question, and I don't know the answer. It depends on your HR department. Have you suggested that the co-worker talk to HR? Is there an anonymous system for filing complaints?
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: No, the company hasn't set up a system for passing along info that way. I don't know if she has talked to HR. She might not have because she's worried that it'll get back to her boss, and she'll get punished. I'd like to be supportive, even if I can't help solve the problem.
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: That's a good attitude. You want to be supportive and helpful. You sound like a good co-worker. Remember that the problem did not start with you, so you do not need to feel responsible for it.
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: Thanks for your words of encouragement? Maybe there is little I can do, but I don't want to let the problem fester. She's a great co-worker and a great worker. We need her on the team. What do you think a good first step would be?
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: That's a good question. I would show support for her and empathize with her and her situation. Do you have lunch with her? Can you send her a text letting her know she's valued? She might appreciate that.
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: Sometimes we have lunch, but usually she just eats at her desk. I could easily send her texts of encouragement.
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: Ok. That's a good first step. I think you have a way forward with this. Maybe after a few texts, you can sit down and talk about solutions in detail, like going to HR.
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: Ok. I'll try sending a couple of texts every day. Then I'll see if she wants to have lunch outside with me when the weather gets better.
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: That's a good positive step. I think that you've got a pretty handle on the situation. Good for you!
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: Thanks. The boss is pretty good at his job. He know how to manage projects and he's good with clients. There is just this one thing that he gets wrong and somebody needs to get him to stop.
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: I understand that you're frustrated and sad. I would feel the same way too. I think that anyone else in your situation would feel the same way.
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: Thanks. I guess I just have to accept things as they are. I can't afford to leave this job, and it's impossible to find another job at this time. Plus I don't want to abandon my co-worker in her time of need.
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: Well, you have to do what is right for yourself. If you find a better job, think seriously about taking it. Your co-worker will not be there forever. You have a responsibility to yourself.
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: True. I hadn't thought of it that way. I should consider my needs. Thanks!
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: You're welcome! I'm glad that I was able to help you!
source_refs.speaker: supporter

source_refs.exact_quote: I feel a lot better now. I start sending text messages to my co-worker on Monday. Thanks! Have a good day!
source_refs.speaker: seeker

source_refs.exact_quote: You too! Have a great day, and good luck with work!
source_refs.speaker: supporter
